premises.text: Streaming services have not caught up with the demand for comedy content
premises.evidence_span: streaming hasn't caught up so now you only have about 10% of the comedy that's available and only 1% of the market

premises.text: There is a significant interest in stand-up comedy among social media users
premises.evidence_span: out of the hundred and sixty million people that are actually registered on Facebook 91 million of them said that stand-up comedy is one of their top five interests

premises.text: The Laughley app has a growing library of comedians and tracks
premises.evidence_span: we have over 400 comedians and 20,000 tracks already on the site

premises.text: The app includes features like a profanity filter and subscription options for ad-free content
premises.evidence_span: you can actually turn on the profanity filtering and it all of a sudden weeds out anything that's got dirty words in it

premises.text: The technology behind Laughley allows for advanced search and categorization of comedy content
premises.evidence_span: we have a technology which allows us to transcribe every single joke in the text

premises.text: Comedians are incentivized to promote the app through a revenue-sharing model
premises.evidence_span: we share revenue with them for every single stream

premises.text: The app has support from industry professionals and record labels
premises.evidence_span: we have a tremendous amount of industry support

value.text: Fans of comedy can access a wide range of content through a dedicated streaming platform
value.evidence_span: the very first app that's built from the ground up to focus on streaming comedy

notes: Traction metrics and specific comedian names are excluded as they do not constitute premises.
